_comment: Hand-curated capital-structure events taken from SEC filings (each has its source). Used only to place known jumps BETWEEN the automatic anchors (10-Q/10-K XBRL quarter-ends, weekly 8-K balances, Strategy KPI API). The automatic anchors always win on their own dates. Amounts in USD millions unless noted.

debt_flows.note: Issued $1.01B 0.625% convertible notes due 2028 (8-K 2024-09-20). The $500M 6.125% senior secured notes redemption around the same time is picked up by the 2024-09-30 10-Q anchor.
Issued $2B 0% convertible notes due 2030 (8-K 2025-02-24). Conversions or redemptions of older notes in Q1 2025 appear only at the 2025-03-31 10-Q anchor.

debt_anchors.note: Repurchased $1.5B of 2029 notes during May 11-25, 2026; principal went from $8.21B to $6.71B (press release 2026-05-26 and 8-K 2026-07-27)

preferred_ipos.note: EUR 100 stated amount; converted to USD at that day's EURUSD

preferred_check.note: '$15.5 billion aggregate notional amount of preferred stock outstanding' (press release 2026-05-26), rounded; used only as a check

debt_anchors.note: Strive had no debt before the Semler merger (10-Q 2025-09-30)
Semler merger: assumed Semler's 4.25% convertible notes due 2030 (~$100M = $90M later exchanged + ~$10M left, see below) plus a $20M Coinbase loan (8-K 2026-01-28; 10-Q shows $20M debt assumed)
$90M of Semler notes exchanged for ~930k SATA, and the $20M Coinbase loan retired (8-K 2026-01-28). About $10M of notes left (10-Q fair value $9.7M at 2026-03-31).
Remaining notes repaid in Q2 2026 (10-Q: notes repayments $9.97M); exact date not disclosed, so the step is placed at quarter-end

sata_points.note: SATA IPO settled 2025-11-10 (8-K). The IPO share count is not in the 8-K text, so the 2025-12-31 count (2,012,729) is back-filled.
Follow-on of 1,320,000 SATA plus ~930,000 SATA from the notes exchange, added to the year-end 2,012,729 (8-K 2026-01-28). The 2026-02-11 count was 4,265,518.

sats_points.note: SATS did not exist until its October 2026 IPO

SATS IPO settled 2026-10-20 (8-K 2026-10-16). The step is placed on 2026-10-23, the date of the first weekly 8-K table showing both the 7,000,000 SATS and the cash/BTC from the raise, so EV doesn't count the new preferred for 3 days before its proceeds show up.
